message:
There's an ASAN build config. Let me rebuild mruby with ASAN. First, let me clean and rebuild with the ASAN config:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && ruby minirake clean 2>&1 | tail -5 && MRUBY_CONFIG=build_config/clang-asan.rb ruby minirake 2>&1 | tail -30' 2>&1 | head -50</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
